description: AgroMo is an agro-ecological modelling suite developed by its research contributors. It combines a crop model, an ecosystem biogeochemistry model and a simple economic component to simulate land-use and management scenarios. Users specify weather, soils, crops or vegetation, land use and agricultural operations; outputs include crop, soil-water, carbon and nitrogen indicators for the selected land and period. Geographic coverage is user-defined, with examples and source material in English and Hungarian. GPL-3.0 source and usage guidance are public. A limitation is that parameters and management practices must be matched to local crops and soils; simulated yield or water use is not a measured demand series. AgroMo can explore irrigation demand or watershed conditions that affect water infrastructure. The related catalogue ESA WorldCover record is a land-cover product, not a calibrated AgroMo initial state. No weather files, crop data or package were downloaded.
